WPFluent: The framework FluentPlayer is built on — a Laravel-style application layer (router, models, request lifecycle) for WordPress plugins.
policy: A WPFluent authorization class under app/Http/Policies that gates a REST route group by checking a capability before the controller runs.
smartcode: A merge-tag token (for example a FluentCRM contact field) that FluentPlayer resolves to a real value in supported player text.
dynamic source: A media source resolved at render time from a URL, post meta, or filter override rather than a fixed stored value.
layer: An interactive element rendered over the player — a text/button overlay, CTA/action bar, hotspot, or ad.
coverage: The fraction of a media's distinct content actually watched, computed by merging overlapping watched segments. The basis for completion in the progression evaluator.
Vidstack: The underlying open-source media player element FluentPlayer wraps (with hls.js for HLS streaming).
